title: Puzzle 3D Camera Becomes Per-Window Session-Only View Action
description: Convert Puzzle 3D's camera/projection actions (setCamera, setProjection, setProjectionParam, focusSelection) from ActionKind::Operation to ActionKind::View so orbiting/panning/zooming never creates a VCS-tracked document edit and shows up correctly in the new session-only command-history log. Move the camera field out of the document (Puzzle3dProjection/Puzzle3dFixture) into per-window runtime state (Puzzle3dWindowOptions), since this app supports multiple independent windows viewing the same document. Delete the SetCamera operation variant from the op crate entirely (hard cutover, no migration). Hand-fix the two .puzzle3d example fixtures and op-crate test fixtures that referenced the camera document field/operation.
summary: Converted Puzzle 3D's camera/projection actions (setCamera, setProjection, setProjectionParam, focusSelection) from ActionKind::Operation to ActionKind::View. Moved the camera field out of the document (Puzzle3dProjection in the semio-s-app-puzzle-3d crate, and the structural-twin Puzzle3dFixture in semio-s-app-puzzle-3d-ui) into per-window runtime state — added a `camera: Puzzle3dCamera` field to Puzzle3dWindowOptions (and the flat Puzzle3dRuntime.camera scratch mirror), threaded through the existing load_window/save_window per-window materialization so split top/perspective panes never share a camera. Deleted the Puzzle3dOperation::SetCamera variant, its Puzzle3dDiff.camera field, and every diff/apply/absorb/backwards/document-delta match arm referencing it from semio-s-app-puzzle-3d-op (hard cutover, no migration). Hand-fixed the two .puzzle3d example fixtures (concrete-forest, nakagin-capsule-tower) to drop their `camera { ... }` DSL blocks, and the dsl/op crates' unit-test fixtures that referenced the camera field. Added two new tests to the ui crate's existing test module: camera_actions_are_view_actions_that_emit_no_document_operations (asserts ActionKind::View + empty operations for all four actions) and set_camera_is_per_window_and_leaves_sibling_windows_and_the_document_untouched (dispatches setCamera on window A, asserts window B's rendered camera and the shared document are both unaffected). All four touched crates (semio-s-app-puzzle-3d, -dsl, -op, -ui) pass cargo check --all-targets with zero errors. Test counts: puzzle-3d 0/0, puzzle-3d-dsl 2/2, puzzle-3d-op 2/2, puzzle-3d-ui 69/73 passing — the 4 ui-crate failures (fill_build_tick_is_a_view_action_with_narrow_ui_scope, set_fill_count_declares_narrow_ui_scope, set_hover_is_a_view_action_with_no_ops_after_document_mutation, set_object_kind_weight_declares_fill_options_ui_scope) are pre-existing and unrelated to this change: they fail on `panel_bodies.is_empty()` because semio-framework-plugin's VcsDocumentApp now unconditionally injects FRAMEWORK_HISTORY_BODY_KEY into panel_bodies for every action (the sibling in-progress command-history mechanism, out of scope per this ticket's instructions) — confirmed by these same 4 failing for actions (setHover, fillBuildTick, setFillCount, setObjectKindWeight) this ticket never touched.
